name: Blood for Blood
label: Quest
description: Blood for Blood: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A number of our Windshaper novices were found dead in the Highlands this morning. We can't be certain but there is a strong chance that the Al'Aketh are responsible. Windshapers trade blood for blood, every time.
Head north and kill any Al'Aketh you encounter. Bring me their windstone prayer charms as proof of the deed. We do not forgive and we do not forget.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Al'Aketh have engaged in their bloody zealotry for far too long. This is only the start of the reckoning they face.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ayessa looks shaken and distant as you hand her the windstone charms.
Don't mind me, friend. Today has merely been... A trying day. Thank you for your service to the windshapers thus far.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
